I have a small plot of 0.21 hectares for sorghum, and with the land being my own, I need to make the most of what I have without spending too much. I will use some inorganic fertilizer because it helps with yield, but I cannot afford much, and I will also apply manure since I have some livestock. I will plant local sorghum seed because it is what I have saved from last season and it does well here in Tigray. This plot is small enough that my family and I can manage all the work ourselves, and since sorghum is hardy, I do not see a need for chemicals to fight pests or for irrigation.
